prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 93.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Archetype Grid Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a dynamic grid layout highlighting pet personality archetypes and visual behavioral badges. (why: The adoption step drops to 74.4% conversion and takes a median of 89s; presenting pet traits clearly in a structured grid helps users decide faster.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] New Pet Trait Builder Pre-Screen: Introduces a dedicated companion trait preview screen prior to picking a friend so users configure behavioral temperament upfront. (why: Adoption stage experiences substantial friction (74.4% conversion); configuring traits early increases emotional connection before photo asset generation.)
2: [home, new_flow] Waiting Stage Live Desktop Spawn Simulator Flow: Replaces the static waiting view with a live desktop spawn simulator flow that demonstrates pet movements while generation completes. (why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and leads to post-onboarding confusion regarding how the pet functions on the desktop.)
3: [finish, redesign] Finish Step Quick Control Command Summary: Redesigns the home intro view into a full checklist summary explaining essential mouse shortcuts and tray controls. (why: The finish step drops to 69.7% completion, and multiple support emails noted confusion about controlling, hiding, or summoning pets post-setup.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Story Welcome Interactive Playful Mascot Greeting: Adds an animated mascot spotlight component to the initial story welcome screen to establish immediate visual engagement. (why: Mean time spent on the choose_path step is high (514s); upfront mascot visuals establish clear product context quickly.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Cloud Recovery Reassurance: Adds explicit hint messaging on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing companion data will be restored. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in, indicating significant sign-in anxiety for returning users.)
6: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Validation Checklist Component: Displays a dynamic photo quality requirement checklist banner below the photo upload area. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly due to source photo issues.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Render Progress Notification Toggle: Enables live completion timers and desktop notification opt-ins on the asset render waiting screen. (why: Waiting takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s); giving users exact time estimates and desktop notification alerts prevents drop-offs.)
8: [finish, hint] Home Intro Companion Trait & Desktop Tray Guide: Adds explicit hint guidance on how to recall pets via the system tray if they disappear from the desktop screen. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on screen and 3 about controlling/hiding pets after completing setup.)
